items.title: Launch of a Cooperation Project for Women’s and Girls’ Leadership in Senegal
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 24 LUG - The Italian Ambassador to Senegal, Michele Tommasi, spoke at the first meeting of the National Steering Committee for the Parel/F project—an initiative funded by Italian Cooperation to strengthen the leadership and socioeconomic inclusion of women and girls in Senegal—to reaffirm Italy’s support for this initiative. items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 21 LUG - Italian Ambassador to Senegal Michele Tommasi attended the opening ceremony of the Gorée School 2026, organized as part of the project “Training, Dignity, Inclusion, and Innovation in Senegal,” funded by Italian Cooperation. Organized by the Institute for the Rights of Migrant Workers, in partnership with Inca Cgil Senegal, VIS, and numerous Italian and Senegalese institutional and social actors, the Gorée School serves as a unique forum for dialogue and exchange. items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.

items.description: [Dabanga] Amsterdam / Kampala -- The 11th voluntary return flight carrying Sudanese refugees from Uganda to Sudan departed on Thursday with 80 returnees on board.
